checks.name: touch steering moves the cell without a keyboard
touch bite consumes nearby prey for DNA and biomass
predator contact damages once and respects cooldown
dash creates distance and a temporary safe window
touch dash button activates the escape action
equipped organs are visible and change movement mechanics
all four selectable organs change the visible cell silhouette
first growth threshold automatically opens mutation editor
nearby predator gets a distance and danger warning
two biomass thresholds lead through two mutations to the final exit win
zero-health loss and restart clear the expedition state

productionBuild.warning: Vite still warns that the main entry exceeds 500 kB.

visualChanges: HUD now names the active two-organ build.
The bite control glows and changes label while prey is in reach.
Nearby predators show a distance and directional danger warning; the exit mission keeps its own bearing cue.
Camera follow interpolation is time-based to remain responsive at low frame rates.

qualitativeComparison.sameSeedAgainstIteration04: The iteration-5 final encounter frame adds a visible build label and relocates the predator warning away from the cell and enemy silhouettes, making the current tactic and danger easier to read.
qualitativeComparison.userReference: The palette retains teal water, translucent original organisms, bubbles, and microflora. Only a still reference is available; no original executable or gameplay was provided, so no gameplay superiority claim is made.
qualitativeComparison.assetProvenance: Cell, prey, predator, nutrient, and gate meshes are procedural original geometry; no Spore/EA assets or logos are used.

limitations: Only 844x390 touch-capable headless Chromium was tested; no physical Android device or 800x360/915x412 viewport QA has been performed.
Automated E2E accelerates biomass thresholds and final travel with test hooks; real pickups, touch steering, bite, dash, and the separate milestone simulation tests are covered.
The production service worker/offline cache, pause/resume, and 30 FPS fallback remain for later iterations.
The production build is below 10 MB, but the 6.760 MB JS entry still triggers the Vite chunk warning.
